summary_text: 13 open tickets, 2 critical, 3 high, 5 medium, 3 low. The two critical issues — Safari date picker and silent session expiry — block core POS workflows across user segments. High-severity items (mobile nav broken, notification miscounts, silent API failures) compound the risk for on-the-go staff and order-critical flows. No tickets are in progress, meaning zero active remediation despite the severity mix.
top_risks: Unannounced session expiry can cause data loss mid-transaction
Safari breakage blocks iOS Safari users — significant mobile POS segment
Mobile nav broken + notification badge wrong creates compounding UX failure on mobile

action_items.problem: Date picker broken on Safari — likely missing -webkit- prefix, date input polyfill, or Safari-incompatible date library
action_items.solution: Audit date picker component for cross-browser support: polyfill for Safari's lacking date input support, add -webkit-appearance and touch-target styles, test on Safari 15–17. Use flatpickr or native Intl.DateTimeFormat fallback if using <input type='date'>.

action_items.problem: Session expires without warning — no idle timer UI or pre-expiry notification to save work
Session expires without warning — no idle timer UI or pre-expiry notification to save work
action_items.solution: Add session-lifecycle observer on frontend: show warning modal at T-60s before expiry with 'Extend Session' button, trigger auto-save draft on expiry timer. Backend: ensure session TTL is returned in auth response headers so frontend can track remaining time.

action_items.problem: Mobile nav menu broken — likely touch-event or z-index issue with hamburger/drawer
action_items.solution: Check hamburger toggle handler for touch events (add touchstart listener), verify drawer z-index > overlay and body overflow hidden on open. Test on iOS Safari and Chrome Android. Use CSS :has() selector fallback for older WebKit.

action_items.problem: Notification badge shows wrong count — stale state or WebSocket message dedup failure
action_items.solution: Trace notification reducer: verify WebSocket messages are deduplicated by ID (not replayed), check badge calculation reads from unread count not total count, add server-side count verification endpoint for client sync every 30s.

action_items.problem: API timeout returns no user-facing error message — user sees blank/spinner forever
action_items.solution: Add Axios/fetch interceptor with configurable timeout (default 15s), catch timeout errors and show 'Request timed out. Check your connection and try again.' toast. Backend: verify request-scoped timeout middleware is configured on POST routes with body parsing.

action_items.problem: Export CSV is missing columns — likely column mapping mismatch between query and CSV serializer
action_items.solution: Compare DB query SELECT columns against CSV header definition in exporter; add unit test that checks header count matches data length per row. Verify joined/fk columns are aliased correctly.

action_items.problem: Avatar upload fails for files >1MB — missing multipart size limit or client-side validation
action_items.solution: Add 5MB limit server-side in file upload middleware (multipart.MaxMemory or nginx client_max_body_size), add client-side check before upload with 'File too large (max 5MB)' message, compress oversized images client-side with canvas API before upload.

action_items.problem: Pagination resets when sorting a column — state coupling between sort and page number in URL/state
action_items.solution: Reset page to 1 on every sort change before firing the API request. In URL state (query params), order params so sort change clears page param. Add integration test: sort column, verify page=1 and previous page data is replaced.

action_items.problem: Form validation fires too early — validates on mount or on first keystroke before user interaction
action_items.solution: Add 'touched' field tracking per control: only show validation error after blur or after user has modified the field. Use useForm's shouldValidate: 'onBlur' or 'onSubmit' config. Reset touched state on field clear.

action_items.problem: Email template has broken layout — likely missing table-based fallback or inline CSS for email clients
action_items.solution: Convert email templates to table-based layout with inline styles only (no <style> tags). Test on Litmus/Email on Acid for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail. Add MJML preprocessor or Foundation for Emails if templates are authored in HTML.

action_items.problem: Dark mode flickers on load — flash of unstyled content before theme script runs
action_items.solution: Inline theme-detection script in <head> before CSS loads: check localStorage theme preference or prefers-color-scheme media query and set data-theme attribute immediately. Prevents FOUC by applying class before paint.

action_items.problem: Search ignores special characters like +, @, # — likely query builder strips/escapes them incorrectly
action_items.solution: Audit search query sanitizer: allow alphanumeric + common specials (+@#.-_), escape only SQL/NoSQL injection characters. Add test cases for product codes containing '+' or '#'.

action_items.problem: Table sort direction indicator shows wrong state — data sorts correctly but arrow icon points wrong way
action_items.solution: Check sort-direction state toggle: verify ascending → descending → none cycle matches the icon class applied. Review reducer/parent component to ensure active sort column + direction are correctly paired in state.
